title: Remove the work_run_evidence.source_revision column after evaluation and content-v1 cleanup
outcome: Remove the work_run_evidence.source_revision column after evaluation and content-v1 cleanup
acceptance: After the switch, a recorded inventory lists every real reader and writer of work_run_evidence.source_revision, and of any path that duplicates the value out of canonical JSON.

The column and its duplicating paths are gone from the current schema. Historical canonical_json, ids and links are byte-for-byte unchanged and still read as stored, and no fingerprint is computed to replace the column.

The changeset states its store consequence from the actual schema and projection repair rules; if a migration is needed, its plan is shown to Greg before any store is touched, and import names and reports what it retires. No destructive step runs without that.
